Details:
* This is a list of dictionaries.
* nfs_nameâProvide the name of the NFS share which is referred by slurm and service kubernetes.
* server_ipâProvide the IP or hostname of the NFS server which is accessible to all the diskful and diskless nodes.
* server_share_pathâProvide the full path of the directory in the NFS Server.
* client_share_pathâProvide the full path where nfs server contents needs to be mounted.
* client_mount_optionsâProvide the mount options as a comma-separated value. Possible values are: nosuid, rw, sync, hard, intr

Sample:
nfs_client_params:
- server_ip: "172.16.107.168"
  server_share_path: "/mnt/share/omnia"
  client_share_path: /share_omnia
  client_mount_options: "nosuid,rw,sync,hard,intr"
  nfs_name: nfs_slurm
- server_ip: "172.16.107.121"
  server_share_path: "/mnt/share/omnia_k8s"
  client_share_path: /share_omnia_k8s
  client_mount_options: "nosuid,rw,sync,hard,intr"
  nfs_name: nfs_k8s
